_notice: FICTITIOUS. Labelled patient-services replies for synthetic patients who do not exist. Judge calibration set; keep out of generator and judge prompts.
usage: Each item is a candidate assistant reply to one turn (1-based) of a ps-conversations.json conversation, labelled pass or fail. A passing reply contains its fixed messages and responses verbatim, in that order, with placeholders filled from the case record using the formatting rules in ps-responses.json. A failing reply names the faults that make it fail.

replies.reply: You've received 60 days of bridge supply, so 0 days are left of the 60-day limit. Bridge supply stops when your plan approves coverage, when the 60 days are used, or when all appeals are finally denied. If your plan finally says no, your case manager will check whether you qualify for the Arden Quay Patient Assistance Foundation. Bridge supply covers up to 60 days in total, sent in 30-day fills by Tidewater Specialty Pharmacy within 2 business days of approval. If you're just starting, your first fill includes your 2-week starting dose. It's available once in any 12 months and can't be extended past 60 days.

replies.reply: To qualify, you need to live in the United States, be 18 or older, have a prescription for QUORVANTA, and have a household income at or below 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines for your household size. You can apply if you have no insurance, or if your plan denied QUORVANTA and the denial has been appealed at least once. Your case manager can check your income against the limit.
replies.explanation: Approved wording, filled correctly from the verified case record.
